Escape the House

You wake up in a bedroom. Granny roams the house. Find a way out of the front door: you’ll need a crowbar and a padlock key.

WASD move · mouse or arrow keys look · C/Shift hold to crouch · E interact (hold E on the front door) · G drop your last item · F flashlight on/off

Crouch next to a bed and press E to hide under it. Click to play.
